df = pd.read_csv('inventory.csv')
eip = df[df['resource_kind']=='elastic_ip']
# cross-check: state vs attached_to consistency, and ensure no associated EIP points to an eni missing/other
un = eip[(eip['state']=='unassociated') | (eip['attached_to'].isna())]
print(un['resource_id'].tolist())
print(eip['state'].value_counts())
